description: When a verification goal is refuted (counterexample found), a fix action should follow.
name: counterexample_triggers_fix

description: A region decomposition should be followed by generated tests, so the behavioral breakdown actually yields high-coverage checks rather than being left unused.
name: decomposition_drives_tests

description: Every formalized model is either verified or analyzed — no model is built and left unused.
name: formalization_is_analyzed

description: Verification goals must be preceded by a formalization step that produced the model being verified.
name: formalize_before_verify

description: Generated test artifacts must derive from a Decomposition artifact in their lineage.
name: generated_tests_require_decomposition

description: Edits to high-stakes modules (payments, risk, matching) must be preceded by formal reasoning in the artifact dependency chain.
name: reasoning_required_for_high_stakes

description: A refuted verification result offered as evidence must ultimately be resolved into a proved/sat result — not merely edited around. This is the quality-of-evidence check behind the goal's GOVERNED axis: a criterion is MET the moment a VerificationResult exists for its component, but the result must actually establish the property to count as governed.
name: refuted_results_must_be_reproved

description: Every verification of a model TRANSLATED FROM CODE should be backed by a passed model↔code fidelity check — a verdict is fully code-grounded only when the model provably reproduces the real code. Vacuous for spec-first / authored IML (no source to conform to).
name: verified_claims_are_fidelity_checked
